_note: The wording of these strings before the plain-language pass (2026-11-04). Same ids as src/shell/plain-copy.js. {n} and {word} are sample slots. Kept so the readability numbers can be re-measured.
streakRule: A day counts once you study for 5 minutes on a lesson, review or practice screen. The timer pauses after a minute without a tap.
settingsIntro: No recorded voices exist yet: the Man/Woman choice is a saved preference. Sound currently comes from your browser's text-to-speech voice. See "How this works".
persistNo: This browser does not offer protected storage. Progress is saved on this device only; download a backup now and then.
persistYes: Your progress is protected from automatic browser clean-up. Clearing site data in browser settings still deletes it, so keep a backup file.
persistMaybe: Your progress is saved on this device but the browser may remove it when space is short or after a long time unused. Download a backup now and then.
wipeHelp: This permanently deletes your progress, review cards, streaks and settings from this device. Tick the box below to remove the offline copy of the app too. It cannot be undone, so download a backup first. Type DELETE to turn on the button.
restoreWarn: Restoring replaces the progress and settings on this device. If you are unsure, press Cancel and download a backup of what is here now first.
lessonDraft: Draft: a native Hebrew speaker has not yet checked the English meanings or the vowel marks.
hooksNote: Memory hooks written for this course (a draft; the stories are teaching aids, not history).
quickCheckMany: Quick check: 3 questions. The lesson counts as complete when you finish it.
exDraft: This exercise and its content are drafts. Nothing here has been reviewed by a native Hebrew speaker or tested with learners.
closingPerfect: Every answer right first time. Come back to review in a day or two to see what stuck.
closingSolid: Solid. 3 to look at again; they are in your review.
closingTough: That was a tough one. 3 to look at again; they are in your review, and trying the lesson once more is fine.
notifyOpenOnly: Reminders fire only while ALEF is open in this browser (an open tab, or the installed app in the foreground). Nothing can wake it when it is closed; for that, import the calendar's reminder file into your phone's calendar.
streakNone: A streak counts the days you study for 5 minutes or more, on a lesson, review or practice screen.
welcomeBackDue: Welcome back. Nothing to catch up on. Ease in with a few review cards, and stop whenever you like. Or go straight to your next step below.
skippedNote: 3 skipped (not counted either way). Do the exercise again to answer them.
sprintNote: Words counted for a destination are the ones our list recognises in that line, not every word in it. Wrong answers just bring the word back later.
progressNoStreak: No streak running right now. A day counts after 5 minutes of study on a lesson, review or practice screen.
progressRestNote: A rest day does not break your streak. The streak counts a day after 5 minutes of study. The card goal below is a separate, gentle target.
